_readme: Every value you will change later lives here. After editing, run: python3 build.py   Empty string means 'not set yet'.

preorder._note: Leave url empty to show the 'Pre-order opens December 1' state. Paste the retailer link to turn the button on.

endorsement._note: Leave quote empty to hide the whole section.

cover._note: Put the final cover JPG in assets/source/ and point to it here. If the file is missing, a marked placeholder is shown.
cover.alt: Cover of Escape Velocity by Olawale Oladehin

logo._note: Put the Stack logo SVG in assets/source/ and point to it here. If missing, a type-set placeholder of the Stack logo is shown.

fonts._note: Names go first in the CSS font stack. To self-host, put .woff2 files in assets/source/fonts/ and list them in files.
fonts.displayFallback: Palatino Linotype, Palatino, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif
fonts.sansFallback: Futura, Century Gothic, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
